text.description_html:
AHI SIG722-P22 Contemporary Stainless Flush Ring Pull

This is a heavy duty contemporary design flush mount ring pull. The 2-3/4 inch square stainless steel flush ring pulls is extremely resistant to corrosion making it an ideal material for door hardware. It needs little looking after and does not easily degrade in appearance or function with use. The Matte Black Stainless Steel Contemporary Flush Mount Door Pull is for use on swinging doors, sliding doors, trap doors, cabinet doors. Any door where a flush with the door face pull is desired.

Specifications for the AHI SIG722-P22 Stainless Flush Ring Pull:

  • Material: Stainless Steel
  • Finish: Matte Black
  • Total Height: 2-3/4" (70 MM)
  • Total Width: 2-3/4" (70 MM)
  • Total Depth: 9/16" (14 MM)
  • Door Cutout Depth: 7/16"
  • Projection: 1/8" (If square face is not mortised)
  • Door Cutout Diameter: 2-5/16"
  • 1/8" Thick Solid Stainless Steel
  • Packaged with matching matte black mounting screws
  • AHI SIG722 Dimensions (PDF)

Note: If the square flush pull face is NOT mortised into the door, it will have a 1/8" projection off the doors face.

Sold Individually
